animated.description:
Sweep a highlight while the user permits motion. Set false to use a static
placeholder. Shimmer also stops under reduced motion and forced colours.

block-size.description:
CSS length for the block axis. For text, this is the height of each line.
Use it to reserve the height of the content that will replace the shape.

inline-size.description:
CSS length for the inline axis. Use it to match a fixed content width.
Text and rectangles otherwise fill available inline space.

lines.description:
Number of text lines. Use a whole number from 1 to 20 for the expected
paragraph length. Extra lines are ignored for circles and rectangles.

shape.description: Match the placeholder to the expected text, avatar, or rectangular content.

size.description:
CSS length shared by both axes. Use it for circles or square blocks.
An axis-specific override takes precedence.

--ki-skeleton-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter behind a loading shape. Defaults to none.

--ki-skeleton-bg.description: Base fill of the decorative loading shapes.

--ki-skeleton-bg-image.description: Optional image layered over the static fill. Defaults to none.

--ki-skeleton-circle-radius.description: Proportional corner radius of the circular shape.

--ki-skeleton-highlight.description: Peak colour of the animated loading highlight.

--ki-skeleton-last-line-scale.description: Fraction of the usual line width occupied by the final line in multiline text.

--ki-skeleton-line-size.description: Default height of each text line.

--ki-skeleton-radius.description: Corner radius of text lines and rectangles.

--ki-skeleton-rect-size.description: Default block size of the rectangle.

--ki-skeleton-shimmer-image.description: Image of the moving highlight. Use currentColor to inherit the highlight colour.

component.description: Decorative placeholder shapes that reserve space for loading content.

shape.description: Each painted text line, circle or rectangle.
